content.title: Who Are the Key Players in a Fannie, Freddie IPO?
content.summary: The U.S. Treasury: A deal would likely involve the Treasury selling a portion of the stake it took in the firms in the 2008-09 financial crisis.  When the government put the firms under conservatorship, it wanted to ensure taxpayers—via the Treasury—were adequately repaid for the risk they took to stabilize the mortgage market.  Junior preferred shareholders: Below the senior preferred shares sit roughly $35 billion in outstanding junior preferred shares, according to a 2024 Congressional Budget Office report.

content.title: Cisco & IBM's quantum internet, mortgage rates tick higher
content.description:
Yahoo Finance anchor Julie Hyman tracks Thursday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

Bitcoin (BTC-USD) is extending recent declines, now under the $88,000 mark.

Mortgage rates are ticking higher this week, with the 30-year fixed rate at 6.26% — up from 6.24% last week, according to data from Freddie Mac (FMCC).

Cisco (CSCO) and IBM (IBM) are partnering on a project that the companies say could lead to "quantum internet."

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
